"Understood. Shunt sequence initiated."

"...unstable... hostile... reject..."

The entity is responding to the shunt not with curiosity, but with a desperate burst of data—a defensive overflow. You are suddenly bombarded with information too dense to process, too alien to categorize. The pressure in your chest intensifies until it feels like your lungs cannot draw air.
